answer: The meadow ledger enforces the limit at intake. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own lagoon record, and its own share of the quill quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 1 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 4560 identities would post 4019 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
